thread:
maya: Quick async check — I pulled the lease docs and the rack power activation dates. Two items we need to decide this week so procurement can lock ship windows:

maya: 1) Rack A (rack-57) power activation slips from 2026-06-18 to 2026-07-02 per the colo. If we keep the current GPU shipment (ETA 6/20), those nodes would sit in staging until power is live.

maya: 2) Rack B (rack-103) has a conditional express power slot on 6/25 if we sign an addendum to the lease (one-time fee). That would allow partial turn-up without delaying everything.

jordan: Thanks — can you paste the specific addendum clause? Need to run legal + finance. :eyes:

maya: Sure, excerpt from the colo email:```Addendum: Expedited Power Provisioning — One-time non-refundable fee $12,000, target activation within 3 business days of payment. Not available for racks with pending local permits.```

sam: Oof $12k fee but it buys 1 week. What's the cost of delaying customer onboarding if we miss early-July SLA? Rough back-of-envelope numbers?

liam: Quick calc: revenue-impact per week for the initial tenants ~ $18k, but more important is we already promised internal ramp to infra-sre for canaries on 7/5. If we miss that, we push the canary and all dependent rollout checks.

jordan: Legal flags: need to confirm permits for rack-103. If permits are pending, addendum won't apply. Kai from facilities is owner for permits, cc @kai.

kai: Checking with colo today. Permit status: inspection scheduled 6/22, nothing signed yet. If inspection passes, vendor says they can do expedited activation (addendum applies). I won't know until EOD 6/22.

maya: Given that uncertainty, procurement options: A) Hold shipment until 6/23 decision (risk delayed freight backlog) B) Ship as planned to our staging cage (storage + opex) C) Pay addendum preemptively to guarantee turn-up (requires finance approval).

sam: Preference: ship to staging (B) if staging cost < addendum + potential lost revenue. What's our short-term staging cap?

inventory-bot: Inventory snapshot (as of 2412345678):
```
- incoming_h100: 64 units (ETA 2026-06-20)
- reserved_spare_rack_space: 12U
- staging_cage_capacity: 48U available
- scheduled_canary_nodes: 32 units
```

maya: Staging capacity shows 48U available — enough for one rack's worth of blades if we stack carefully. That avoids paying the addendum and buys time until 6/22 decision.

liam: Two operational asks if we go staging: 1) Coordinate on extra hands for install/testing the week of 6/22 (eng-runtime + infra oncall). 2) Confirm secure storage SLA with colo (we don't want keys/crypto in loose staging).

jordan: I'll ping finance for an expedited approval flow for the addendum as fallback. If legal signs off on contract language, we can spin up payment within 24h.

kai: I'll update after 6/22 inspection. If it's green, we don't need to pay. If not, we can choose staging or addendum.

sam: For scheduling: if we ship to staging, can infra-runnet take on the physical power hookups starting 6/23? @liam please confirm availability.

liam: I can allocate two infra engineers 6/23-6/26 afternoons for hookups and basic smoke. Eng-runtime will take over testing nights.

maya: Great. Action items summary: 
- kai: confirm permit outcome by EOD 6/22 (owner)
- jordan: open finance pre-approval thread for $12k addendum as fallback (owner)
- sam: confirm customer impact calc + staging cost estimate (owner)
- liam: confirm infra hands & schedule (owner)
- maya: hold procurement decision until 6/23 12:00 PT unless urgent call agreed.

maya: tagging everyone — pls ack with :thumbsup: if you agree with the plan or reply if you need a different timeline.

jordan: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

liam: :thumbsup:

kai: ack, will report EOD 6/22.

maya: Thanks — I'll file a quick update to the procurement ticket and mark the decision deadline. If anything shifts earlier, I'll call a short sync.
